rubric: 1=AIXM5.2 open · 2=AIXM5.1/4.5 or open ARINC424 · 3=open structured/clean eAIP · 4=open eAIP irregular · 5=eAIP free-account (EAD) · 6=open vector PDF · 7=PDF portal/account · 8=scanned PDF(OCR) or account+agreement · 9=restricted/paid · 10=paper/none (+1 for portal/scale friction)

countries.notes: Open Eurocontrol-style eAIP HTML plus openly published AIXM 5.1 datasets and PDF charts each AIRAC; AIXM path directly machine-readable — easiest non-US source here.
Open free CIFP coded procedures in ARINC 424-18 (28-day cycle, no account); NASR also in AIXM 5.1 and d-TPP vector-PDF charts.
Open access; DAP East/West instrument procedures are vector PDF charts, AIP Book HTML/PDF, eAIP+AIXM migration in progress but not yet the published source.

DGAC IFIS portal at aipchile.dgac.gob.cl serves AIP Vol II (MAP) procedures openly without login. SID/STAR/IAC documents are individual PDF files per airport/procedure (e.g. SCFA STAR 1.pdf). Confirmed vector PDF with selectable text (Excel-to-PDF coordinate tables also published). No AIXM or coded database. AIRAC-aligned amendments, most recent AMDT 66 effective May 2026. Score 6: open vector PDF charts requiring per-airport per-procedure navigation.
Free Basic IFR portal (no login) wraps HTML navigation around per-page PDF documents; AIXM 5.1.1 only via EAD, so the open path forces per-chart PDF parsing.

countries.aip_authority: Centre of Aeronautical Information (CAI), FSUE State ATM Corporation
countries.notes: Open bilingual RU/EN vector PDFs per aerodrome behind an HTML frameset; parser must handle per-AD PDF navigation, Cyrillic text and chart-graphic layouts.

AIP book sold by NiuSky Pacific for K100 (+K120 supplement); no free public eAIP portal. AIP supplements posted as PDFs on website but main instrument approach charts require purchase. No coded/AIXM data. Quarterly amendment cycle.
Open eAIP HTML viewer plus open AIXM 4.5 / XML_SIA airspace data on data.gouv.fr each AIRAC, but SID/STAR/IAC procedures are PDF charts.
AIP Canada / Canada Air Pilot (CAP) procedures are digital vector PDF only with no open coded/AIXM database; coded data sold via NAV CANADA store.

INAC publishes eAIP HTML at inac.gob.ve/eaip/ but the site is intermittently down (503/unavailable at research time; last confirmed snapshot 2023-12-28). Venezuela faces severe political/economic disruption; INAC revoked foreign airline permits late 2025; GNSS interference reported 2025. eAIP structure appears EUROCONTROL-compliant HTML when online, but reliability is very poor and server is frequently offline. Most recent publicly confirmed cycle: 2023-12-28. Score 8: eAIP HTML in principle but unreliable/offline access, uncertain currency; effectively restricted by outages. Confidence low due to inability to confirm current availability.

countries.aip_authority: SACAA / ATNS (Air Traffic and Navigation Services)
countries.notes: ATNS SmartAIM eAIP HTML at cad.atns.co.za appears publicly accessible (no login seen); also PDF sections via caasanwebsitestorage.blob.core.windows.net. However, server is intermittently 503 and ~300 instrument procedures were suspended as of Oct 2025 (ATNS operational crisis). Quarterly AIRAC cycle. No AIXM coded output. Confidence medium due to server reliability issues and ongoing procedure suspensions.
AIS Center portal behind free sign-up/login; eAIP delivered as HTML index plus PDF procedure charts with clunky portal navigation.
Portal is login-walled (username granted only on email application); no public coded/ARINC424 DB, procedures are PDF charts needing per-chart navigation and Chinese-text handling.

countries.aip_authority: DGAC Ecuador (Dirección General de Aviación Civil)
countries.notes: DGAC IFIS3 portal publishes eAIP in open HTML format without login. Airport sections (AD 2 SEQM, AD 2 SEGU, etc.) list RNAV SID/STAR procedures with links; general text sections (GEN, ENR) are directly readable HTML. Confirmed open access on GEN 0.1 page. Actual procedure legs appear in linked chart pages (not inline tabular), adding navigation friction. Updated through 2026 AICs. No AIXM or coded DB. Score 4: open eAIP HTML with irregular structure (procedure legs in linked PDF charts, not inline tables).

RVA operates an AIP portal at aiprdc.rva.cd requiring account creation (Créer un compte); format appears PDF-based. AAC/RDC is the regulator, RVA the ANSP managing 53 airports. No AIXM or coded data found. French-language content. Confidence medium as portal interior not fully verified.
Openly accessible AURORA eAIP (legacy frameset HTML); GEN/ENR text is HTML but procedures are embedded PDF charts and per-AIRAC dated URLs need cycle-aware navigation (AIXM 5.1 via EAD).

countries.aip_authority: Airways NZ / Aeropath Ltd (on behalf of NZ CAA)
countries.notes: Freely accessible at aip.net.nz (terms-of-use disclaimer only, no registration). Vols 2 & 3 contain IFR instrument procedures (SID/STAR/IAP) as vector PDF charts. Updated 6x per year. No AIXM or coded ARINC 424 database publicly available. Physical subscriptions sold via shop.aeropath.aero.

countries.aip_authority: Airports Authority of India (AAI) — AIM India
countries.notes: Open eAIP, no login; GEN/ENR/AD in HTML but instrument procedures are linked PDF charts, plus per-AMDT folder navigation.

countries.aip_authority: ENAIRE (Entidad Pública Empresarial Aeropuertos Españoles y Navegación Aérea)
countries.notes: ENAIRE publishes open eAIP HTML at aip.enaire.es with SID/STAR/IAP in HTML+PDF per AIRAC cycle (28-day). AIXM 5.1 datasets openly downloadable from DatosDigitales page but cover airspace, obstacles, aerodromes, and en-route data — not coded instrument procedures. Procedures require parsing eAIP HTML + chart PDFs. No registration required. Also accessible via EUROCONTROL EAD (free account).

NAABOL (successor to AASANA, created 2021) publishes AIP Bolivia in PDF format. Subscription requires formal written request, payment proof, and delivery of login credentials. ERAU LibGuides classifies access as 'paid/fee'. AIS portal at ais.naabol.gob.bo was returning 503 at research time. Procedures are published as PDFs; one sample (TARIJA-PMR.pdf) is an image-heavy PDF with raster content. Full AIP effective May 2024 confirmed received by Garmin. Score 9: paid subscription required, PDF format (possibly scanned), access difficult/unreliable. +1 for access friction and unreliable portal.

countries.aip_authority: Avinor AS (AIS authority under Civil Aviation Authority Norway / Luftfartstilsynet)
countries.notes: Avinor publishes standard EUROCONTROL-format eAIP HTML at aim-prod.avinor.no, updated every 28-day AIRAC cycle. SID/STAR/IAP procedure data in HTML tables and PDF chart files. No registration required to browse/read. AIP also available via EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free account) in AIXM 4.5/5.1. eAIP HTML URLs embed AIRAC cycle number and effective date. No open coded ARINC 424 database.

countries.aip_authority: LFV (Luftfartsverket — Swedish Aviation Authority / ANS provider)
countries.notes: LFV publishes eAIP HTML at aro.lfv.se via the AROWeb platform. Current cycle (AIRAC AIP AMDT 4-2026, effective 11 Jun 2026) viewable from index-v2.html. Full AROWeb flight-planning features require account registration; eAIP document browsing and IAIP.zip bulk download are available without login. SID/STAR/IAP in HTML and PDF. Also in EUROCONTROL EAD (free account) as AIXM 4.5/5.1. No open coded procedure database.
Open PDF-based AIP (GEN/ENR/AD) in Spanish/English with SID/STAR/IAC as vector PDF charts; no AIXM (site intermittently returns 503).

countries.aip_authority: CORPAC S.A. (Corporación Peruana de Aeropuertos y Aviación Comercial)
countries.notes: CORPAC publishes a full EUROCONTROL-style eAIP at eaip-peru.corpac.gob.pe in open HTML format (no login required). Airport sections SP-AD 2 SPJC confirmed. Active AIRAC updates through 2025 (AMDT 33/25 effective Jul 2025). ENR 1.5 covers holding/approach/departure procedures. eAIP server intermittently returns 307 redirects and 503 errors during research, reducing confidence slightly. No AIXM or coded DB. Score 4: open eAIP HTML, parseable but server instability and irregular structure add friction.

Aerocivil publishes eAIP Colombia via atnaerocivil.gov.co in open HTML (no login). Current amendment AMDT 71/26 (Apr 2026) confirmed; regular 28-day AIRAC cadence. eAIP HTML pages cover general/enroute sections as readable text; however, actual SID/STAR/IAP procedures for airports (AD 2 sections) are served as separate PDF chart files embedded in the eAIP (e.g. SID - ICAO - RWY 14R 14L EVRA5B ZIP5H.pdf for SKBO). Tabular procedure descriptions also published as PDF supplements. No AIXM or coded DB. Score 6: open but procedures are PDF charts within eAIP structure, plus portal was intermittently unavailable (503) during research. Confidence medium due to server instability.
eAIP-Italia requires free ENAV registration; procedures delivered as PDF charts (AIXM 5.1.1 only via separate AIFS/EAD feed), so a parser needs authenticated sessions plus PDF extraction.

countries.aip_authority: JCAB / Japan AIS Center (AIS Japan, SWIM portal)
countries.notes: Free registration required; provides eAIP HTML+PDF plus AIXM 4.5/5 XML exports, so an AIXM path exists but procedure charts are PDF and access sits behind login.

COCESNA publishes Eurocontrol-style eAIP HTML for all Central American states (from AMDT 25/23). HTML pages contain aerodrome operational text; SID/STAR/IAP procedure charts are linked as separate PDF files (not embedded HTML tables). Open access, no login required. Updated on AIRAC 28-day cycle. Spanish language. PDF charts are vector (text-selectable). No AIXM output.

skeyes publishes open eAIP HTML and PDF at ops.skeyes.be, updated 13 times/year per AIRAC cycle. Belgium and Luxembourg covered together. SID/STAR/IAP procedures in standard EUROCONTROL eAIP HTML tables plus PDF charts. No login required for browsing. Also in EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free account) as AIXM 4.5/5.1. No open coded ARINC 424 database.

countries.aip_authority: LVNL (Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland — Air Traffic Control the Netherlands)
countries.notes: LVNL publishes eAIP HTML at eaip.lvnl.nl updated per 28-day AIRAC cycle. SID/STAR/IAP for EHAM/Schiphol and other airports available as both HTML sections and PDF charts. Direct HTTP fetch blocked by server (403), but document classification sources confirm open/free access (no registration listed). Also in EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free account) as AIXM 4.5/5.1. No open coded procedure database. Confidence medium due to server blocking on verification.

countries.aip_authority: AHAC (Agencia Hondureña de Aeronáutica Civil) / COCESNA
countries.notes: Honduras eAIP published via COCESNA (same platform as Costa Rica). Eurocontrol-style eAIP HTML with operational text in HTML; SID/STAR/IAP procedure charts linked as vector PDFs (e.g. MH_AD-2.MHTG SID RNP RWY02). Open access, no login. AIRAC 28-day cycle. Spanish. No AIXM output. Identical structure and friction level to CR.

NCAA AIS publishes AIP and amendment pages. Portal at ncaa.com.na lists 3 AIP documents but currently shows 'no available documents'; login section present indicating account-gated download. Format is PDF (no eAIP HTML or AIXM evident). No AIRAC-aligned cadence confirmed; amendment-page distribution. No open coded data. Score 8: PDF behind account with uncertain availability.

countries.aip_authority: ANS CR / AIM Centre (Air Navigation Services of the Czech Republic)
countries.notes: Open HTML eAIP at aim.rlp.cz (no registration). Aerodrome sections reference SID/STAR/IAP as linked PDF chart files within the HTML framework; procedure text context in HTML but chart data in vector PDFs. ECAC state — AIXM 5.1 available via EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free registration). Updated each AIRAC cycle.

countries.aip_authority: PANSA (Polish Air Navigation Services Agency) / AIS Poland
countries.notes: eAIP IFR published in HTML format at ais.pansa.pl/eAIPIFR with publicly accessible cycle URLs (no login on direct URLs). The formal AIP Poland subscription product is delivered via MS SharePoint and is paid/subscriber-only. SID/STAR/IAP charts are PDF files referenced from the HTML. ECAC state — AIXM 5.1 via EAD Basic (free registration). Split access model adds friction; scored 5.

Open eAIP portal at eaip.austrocontrol.at (no registration). SID/STAR/IAP procedures are individual vector-text PDF chart files licensed CC BY 4.0. Full AIP ZIP download available. No HTML procedure tables — charts only in PDF. ECAC state — AIXM 5.1 via EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free registration). Updated each AIRAC cycle.

Open HTML eAIP at ais.fi/eaip (no registration). Each AIRAC cycle published at a dated subdirectory URL. Aerodrome sections reference SID/STAR/IAP chart pages as PDF links within the HTML eAIP framework. ECAC state — AIXM 5.1 via EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free registration). Updated each AIRAC cycle.

countries.aip_authority: CAAP (Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines)
countries.notes: Paid annual subscription required via ais.caap.gov.ph ($179-325 USD international / PHP 1,792-5,600 local). eAIP delivered as PDF. April 2026 Indra contract will eventually introduce AIXM-compliant system but not yet live. No free public access to instrument procedures. Subscription covers SID/STAR/IAP charts in PDF format.

countries.aip_authority: Civil Aviation Organization of Iran (CAO.IRI) AIS
countries.notes: English AIP PDFs openly downloadable from a clunky Liferay portal, but per-document navigation, intermittent 503s and chart-graphic procedures make extraction awkward; no AIXM.
Thales AIM eAIP (AIXM 5.1 internal, 28-day AIRAC) behind free registration; procedures as eAIP HTML plus PDF SID/STAR/IAC charts rather than open AIXM downloads.

CAAZ AIP portal (caaz.co.zw/aip) found suspended ('This Account has been suspended') as of June 2026. AIP historically requires active paid subscription; digital data sets or paper distribution per CAAZ documentation. No eAIP HTML or AIXM available publicly. Contact: ais@caaz.co.zw. Score 9: paid/restricted access, portal currently down, poor digital availability.

countries.aip_authority: DHMI (Devlet Hava Meydanlari Isletmesi) / Turkish ANSP
countries.notes: DHMI publishes SID/STAR/IAP charts as scanned-image PDFs (confirmed via binary analysis of LT_AD_2_LTFM_SID and LT_AD_2_LTAC_STAR files: FlateDecode image streams, no embedded text fonts). Portal ssd.dhmi.gov.tr shows AIP SUBSCRIPTION FORM, implying formal subscription step; charts are publicly linked from dhmi.gov.tr/AIPDocuments/ but portal login is indicated. DHMI also publishes AIXM 5.1 and CSV terrain/obstacle datasets per EUROCONTROL confluence page, but instrument procedure data (SID/STAR/IAP charts) remain scanned PDF only. AIRAC cycle cadence followed. +0 portal friction already captured in score-8 for scanned PDF plus account.

countries.aip_authority: skyguide (Swiss Air Navigation Services Ltd, AIM unit) / BAZL (Federal Office of Civil Aviation)
countries.notes: Switzerland's eAIP is distributed exclusively via the skybriefing.com portal operated by skyguide, at a paid annual subscription of CHF 92.50/year for the eAIP (plus CHF 53.30 for eVFR). SID/STAR/IAP procedures are in HTML and PDF behind the paywall. Physical AIP also sold via aimshop-skyguide.ch. Also in EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free account) as AIXM 4.5/5.1 for significant point data. No open coded procedure database. +1 friction penalty applied for paid portal requirement.

countries.aip_authority: Naviair / Danish Civil Aviation and Railway Authority (Trafikstyrelsen)
countries.notes: Open AIP portal at aim.naviair.dk (no registration). All AIP sections including SID/STAR/IAP charts are published as individual vector-text PDF files; no HTML eAIP package found — documents are direct PDF media links. Covers Denmark, Faroe Islands, and Greenland. ECAC state — AIXM 5.1 via EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free registration). Updated each AIRAC cycle.

ZACL AIM portal (aim.zacl.co.zm) manages Zambia AIP. Access requires completing an order form and paying fees by bank transfer to ZACL (Standard Chartered, SWIFT SCBLZMLX). AIP can be downloaded electronically or ordered as hard copy; format is PDF. New AIP issued Feb 2022. No eAIP HTML or AIXM. Upgrading to ICAO AIM systems but no digital open access yet. Score 9: paid subscription, PDF only, formal order process required.

Freely accessible eAIP HTML at aip.caam.gov.my; AIRAC-cycle updates confirmed through 2025-2026. Covers Peninsular Malaysia (WM prefix) and Sabah/Sarawak (WB prefix) under a single AIP. Structured HTML tables parseable; also PDF format available. No AIXM coded data. Electronic-only since 2022.

Isavia publishes full eAIP HTML at eaip.isavia.is with AIRAC cycle indexing. HTML pages (BI-AD-2.BIKF-*-en-GB.html) contain parseable operational text (runway data, comms, navaid tables). SID/STAR/IAP charts are linked as PDF files (e.g. BIKF_7_RWY_19_RNAV_SID.pdf). Open access, no registration required. AIRAC 28-day cycle. English and Icelandic. No AIXM output identified.

Open HTML eAIP at ais.nav.pt (no registration). Covers Portugal mainland, Madeira, and Azores. Aerodrome sections (LP-AD-2.*) are HTML pages; SID/STAR/IAP procedure charts linked as PDF files within the eAIP. ISO download also available free of charge. ECAC state — AIXM 5.1 via EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free registration). Updated each AIRAC cycle.

countries.aip_authority: Department of Civil Aviation (DCA) Myanmar / AIS Myanmar
countries.notes: DCA Myanmar publishes eAIP in HTML and PDF via ais.gov.mm; 4th edition described as available in both AIXM 5.1 XML and PDF. However the eAIP history page (ais.gov.mm/eAIP/history-en-GB.html) shows the last effective issue is 30 MAY 2022 with no 2023/2024/2025 updates detected — likely a result of the ongoing post-coup civil conflict (2021 coup caused ~80% AIS staff strike). AIP is nominally open-access; NOTAM portal requires registration. PBN SID/STAR supplements for Yangon, Mandalay, Heho etc. exist in HTML format within the 2022 edition. Score reflects eAIP-HTML that is open but severely stale and structurally irregular (frameset), with uncertainty about whether AIXM 5.1 download is actually accessible; confidence medium due to stale data and civil disruption.

countries.aip_authority: Naviair / Danish Civil Aviation and Railway Authority (Trafikstyrelsen)
countries.notes: Greenland AIP published by Naviair at aim.naviair.dk. Procedures delivered as individual vector PDF files per airport (BG_AD_2_BGBW_en.pdf, BG_AD_2_BGBW_RNP_Y_RWY_06_1_en.pdf, etc.) directly downloadable without login. No eAIP HTML index confirmed for Greenland section; approach and aerodrome charts are standalone PDFs. PDFs are text-selectable (FrameMaker-generated vector). AIRAC-aligned. Limited airports (major: BGGH Nuuk, BGSF Kangerlussuaq, BGQO Qaqortoq as of Apr 2026).

Pakistan eAIP is published by PAA (post-2022 PCAA/PAA bifurcation) at paawebadmin.paa.gov.pk. eAIP index and HTML sections appear publicly accessible without login (confirmed GEN/index pages reachable). Instrument procedure charts (SID/STAR/IAP) for OPIS, OPKC, OPLA etc. are linked as external PDF files from the HTML AD-2 pages, not embedded as HTML tables. PDF chart format not directly confirmed as scanned vs vector due to server 503 responses during testing, but structure mirrors typical ICAO eAIP-HTML with PDF chart attachments. paawebadmin server returns 503 intermittently suggesting stability issues (minor +0 portal friction). No AIXM coded data. AIRAC 28-day cadence followed with AMDT 01/25 confirmed March 2025. Confidence medium: PDF chart quality unverified.

CAAB AIP described as 'published in loose-leaf paper form' (English only). Digital distribution via password-protected portal (caab.co.bw/aip-login) requiring account registration. AIP, AIP SUP and AIRAC content behind login. No eAIP HTML or AIXM publicly available. Subscription/contact required for paper copy: aishq@caab.co.bw. Score 8: account-gated PDF/paper, no open coded data, format and availability uncertain post-registration.

TCAA AIP covers Dar es Salaam FIR; updated by amendment pages issued ~4 times per year (not strict AIRAC). AIP SUP 03/2019 documented subscription fees for initial purchase and annual renewal, paid via government e-payment gateway or bank transfer. Format is PDF (reprinted amendment pages). TCAA website (tcaa.go.tz) is accessible but AIP pages return 403. No eAIP HTML or AIXM. TCAA is procuring an AIXM 5.x + eAIP system but not yet deployed. Score 8: PDF with paid subscription, portal navigation friction.

Thailand CAAT publishes a full eAIP at aip.caat.or.th, openly accessible without registration; AIRAC-cycle dates visible through 2025/2026 (AMDT 01/26 confirmed). eAIP HTML AD-2 pages link SID/STAR procedures exclusively as external PDF chart files (confirmed for RKSS/VTBS pages: no HTML leg tables, only PDF links). Charts are in a /graphics/ folder as separate PDFs. Server returned 503 on some fetches suggesting intermittent availability. SID/STAR PDF charts confirmed accessible (graphics/280000.pdf linked). No AIXM coded data. Score 6 reflects open vector-PDF-via-portal model; actual PDF chart format (vector vs scanned) could not be directly confirmed due to 503 errors, but CAAT eAIP toolbox documentation suggests machine-generated PDFs likely containing selectable text. Score conservatively set at 6 (open vector PDF via portal).

countries.aip_authority: ASECNA (Agency for the Safety of Air Navigation in Africa and Madagascar)
countries.notes: Madagascar is a founding ASECNA member; AIP served via aim.asecna.aero (eAIP in French-language HTML + PDF charts). Cover page (Jun 2026 AIRAC cycle) accessible without login. Individual procedure charts for FMMI (Antananarivo/Ivato) confirmed accessible as vector PDFs (e.g. 09AD2-FMMI-SID-RNAV11.pdf, STAR-RNAV29.pdf, IAC-ILS). HTML eAIP tables also accessible. Subscription form present for offline/SharePoint download but public online access is open. Procedures-in-chart-PDF format with French-language navigation; no AIXM coded data. Score 7: open vector PDF charts via portal navigation, French interface, no coded database.

countries.aip_authority: Korea Office of Civil Aviation (KOCA) / AIM
countries.notes: South Korea KOCA publishes eAIP at aim.koca.go.kr; HTML AD-2 pages are openly accessible without registration. SID/STAR procedures are referenced exclusively as external PDF chart links (not HTML tables, confirmed for RKSS and RKSI pages). Charts are scanned image PDFs confirmed by binary analysis of RKSI STAR PDF (2025-06-26 issue): content is DCTDecode JPEG streams with no embedded text fonts, requiring OCR. eAIP HTML pages include general aerodrome data (navaids, runways, frequencies) in HTML but all procedure charts (SID/STAR/IAP) are image-scan PDFs. Bilingual Korean/English. AIRAC 28-day cycle with AMDT 13/25 confirmed Dec 2025. No AIXM coded data. Score 8 (scanned PDF, open portal, no account needed).

countries.aip_authority: General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) / Saudi Air Navigation Services (SANS)
countries.notes: Saudi Arabia AIP is published by SANS (Saudi Air Navigation Services) at aimss.sans.com.sa. eAIP HTML pages (airport AD-2 sections) are openly accessible without login and link to procedure charts as separate PDF files. SID/STAR charts are vector-text PDFs (confirmed: OERK STAR RWY 33L-33R aeronautical data tabulation and OEDF SID tabulation PDFs contain embedded TrueType fonts, selectable text, created via Bullzip PDF Printer from MS Word). Additional services (NOTAM/PIB, registration on WBPBS) require free registration per GEN 3.1 documentation. eAIP is current with AIRAC AMDT 06/25 dated June 2025 confirmed. Score 7 reflects eAIP-HTML portal with PDF chart downloads requiring navigation per airport/cycle, and optional free-account for briefing services; vector PDFs lower friction vs scanned. No AIXM coded data.

HungaroControl publishes open EUROCONTROL-spec eAIP HTML at ais.hungarocontrol.hu, no login required. SID/STAR procedure legs are in HTML + linked PDF charts. No AIXM download; obstacle data only in Excel. Also available via EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free registration). AIRAC cycle aligned.

HASP publishes eAIP at aisgr.hasp.gov.gr, open access, no login required. SID/STAR procedures delivered as PDF chart files (e.g. LG_AD_2_LGZA_SID-2_en.pdf) rather than structured HTML procedure tables. Older HCAA portal (ypa.gr/hellasais) required free registration but is superseded by HASP. Also on EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free reg). AIRAC cycle aligned.

countries.aip_authority: SIA / DGAC (Direction des Services de la Navigation Aérienne, France)
countries.notes: French Polynesia is covered under SIA France PAC-P eAIP region. eAIP HTML pages (e.g. FR-AD-2.NTAA-fr-FR.html) are openly accessible under sia.aviation-civile.gouv.fr/media/dvd/eAIP_*/PAC-P/. HTML contains aerodrome operational text; SID/STAR/IAP procedure charts are linked as PDF files. Open access, no account required. AIRAC 28-day cycle. French language. SIA open data also on data.gouv.fr but procedure-level data is chart-PDF only.

Open access PDF AIP at sia-enna.dz, no login required. SID/STAR charts published as individual PDF files per aerodrome (e.g. /PDF/AIP/AD/AD2/DAUH/SID.pdf). Only select aerodromes have SID/STAR charts; others have approach-only. No AIXM or HTML procedure tables. PDFs appear to be vector-text (not scanned) based on file characteristics. AIRAC update cadence confirmed from amendment dates.

GCAA publishes an Integrated AIP (IAIP) as a static PDF. Only publicly accessible version found is dated January 2020 (Guyana-IAIP-latest-jan-2020.pdf); no eAIP HTML, no evidence of AIRAC-cycle updates since then. PDF appears to be FrameMaker-generated vector (text-selectable) not scanned. No current AIRAC-aligned AIP confirmed; contact required for current data. No AIXM output.

KCAA eAIP portal requires paid subscription: USD 200/yr international, USD 100/yr East African. Content available in HTML and PDF formats. SID/STAR procedures in PDF charts and some HTML text. No AIXM data. Portal navigation adds friction. AIRAC cycle aligned.

ECAA publishes a PDF AIP updated twice per year (not full AIRAC cycle). No functioning public eAIP portal found; the ECAA website (ecaa.gov.et) returns 403/503 for AIM pages. AIP distributed by subscription or formal request. No AIXM data. Procedures exist as PDF charts. Confidence medium: no direct verification of current portal or access terms possible.

countries.aip_authority: ASECNA (Agency for Aerial Navigation Safety in Africa and Madagascar)
countries.notes: Republic of Congo (FC) AIP published via ASECNA regional eAIP at aim.asecna.aero, open access without login. eAIP is bilingual French/English HTML for ENR sections; aerodrome SID/STAR procedure legs are in PDF chart files under /cartes/atlas/congo/. No omnidirectional SID at FCBB Brazzaville per eAIP text. No AIXM data. French-first interface and per-chart PDF navigation add friction (+1). AIRAC cycle aligned. Score 7 (open PDF charts behind portal navigation).

countries.aip_authority: BANSA (Bahamas Air Navigation Services Authority) / BCAA
countries.notes: BANSA publishes AIP at bansabahamas.com; no public eAIP HTML structure found. Procedures for MYNN and MYGF exist but are distributed primarily via Jeppesen/Navigraph subscriptions. Official site returned 404 on AIP page; IVAO lists as N/A. PDF charts expected but direct open download not confirmed; likely restricted/portal access. AIRAC-aligned updates.

countries.aip_authority: ASECNA (Agence pour la Sécurité de la Navigation Aérienne en Afrique et à Madagascar)
countries.notes: ASECNA eAIP covers Burkina Faso (DFFD Ouagadougou and DFOO Bobo-Dioulasso). eAIP HTML AD-2 sections are open/no login; AD 2.22 flight procedures field shows NIL in HTML — actual SID/STAR/IAP procedure structure is only in PDF charts linked from the ATLAS sub-section (aim.asecna.aero/html/eAIP/cartes/atlas/burkina faso/…). Charts are vector PDFs (not scanned). AIRAC-aligned; current amendment AIP AMDT 06/26, effective 2026-06-11. No coded ARINC 424 or AIXM export. All content in French. +1 for chart-only procedures requiring per-chart PDF navigation.

countries.aip_authority: INAVIC / ANAC (Instituto Nacional da Aviação Civil / Autoridade Nacional de Aviação Civil)
countries.notes: INAVIC publishes AIP Angola in English, updated twice per year (June and December AIRAC dates). The last confirmed publicly accessible eAIP is from Dec 2009 (inavic.gv.ao now returns 503). The current INAVIC portal (inavic.gov.ao) lists AIP editions up to 2014 with no active download links. No eAIP HTML or AIXM export found; distribution appears to be via AIS office contact (ais@inavic.gv.ao). Navigraph has FNLU charts, confirming procedures exist. Effectively restricted/contact-required for current data; confidence medium as current portal state is unclear.

CAAN publishes eAIP as section-by-section PDF downloads at e-aip.caanepal.gov.np; no registration required. Charts are vector/text PDF (not scanned), confirmed by embedded font metadata. Includes SIDs, STARs, RNP AR approaches (NAVBLUE-designed procedures at VNKT effective 2022). No AIXM data; no eAIP HTML portal. Amendment cycle is quarterly (not AIRAC-aligned). Portal was intermittently unavailable (503) during verification; confidence medium.

countries.aip_authority: CADSUR (Civil Aviation Department Suriname) / AIS Suriname
countries.notes: AIS Suriname publishes AIP at cadsur.sr/ais (6th edition). Documents appear as PDF downloads; SIDs/STARs and instrument approaches covered. No registration gate found on public pages. Portal navigation required to locate individual chart PDFs per aerodrome (SMJP). Main PDF URL (1 AIP SURINAME 6th EDITION.pdf) returned 404 suggesting reorganization; June 2025 update posted. AIRAC cadence.

countries.aip_authority: Afghanistan Civil Aviation Authority (ACAA) / Afghanistan AIS (AFGAIS)
countries.notes: AIP (General, Enroute, Aerodrome Edition 101, effective 19 Feb 2026) available as direct PDF downloads from afgais.com with no login. Documents are text-based PDF (embedded fonts confirmed). However, entire Kabul FIR is uncontrolled Class G with no ATC; instrument procedures are largely contingency/TIBA routes rather than standard ICAO SIDs/STARs. Very few precision approaches remain operational. Extreme instability risk: political situation under Islamic Emirate means AIP content and portal continuity cannot be relied upon. Score reflects open PDF access (+6 base) but elevated +2 for operational instability, near-absence of usable coded procedures, and content-verification impossibility.

Ukrainian airspace fully closed to civil aviation since Feb 2022; EASA CZIB in force at least until July 2026 with no confirmed reopening date. eAIP Ukraine available at aisukraine.net in ISO-format (image-copy of AIP pages) for USD 1,200/year subscription; EAD AIP Library offers alternative with free registration. Airspace closure means procedures may be stale/unchanged. High friction: paid access, wartime disruption, ISO-image format. Score capped at 9 (not 10 as digital eAIP does exist via EAD free-account fallback).

AirNav Ireland publishes open eAIP HTML at airnav.ie (AIRAC-cycle URL pattern /AIRAC/YYYY-MM-DD-AIRAC/html/eAIP/EI-*). General/ENR sections are parseable HTML tables; aerodrome SID/STAR procedures are referenced as linked PDF charts (vector, selectable text) rather than inline HTML tables. No login required. Also available via EAD free-registration. No AIXM download found.

countries.aip_authority: DINACIA (Direccion Nacional de Aviacion Civil e Infraestructura Aeronautica)
countries.notes: DINACIA publishes AIP as individual PDF files at dinacia.gub.uy/ais, directly downloadable without registration. AD 2 sections per aerodrome (e.g. Ad2-9 for SUMU) available openly. SIDs, STARs, and instrument approach charts (including ILS CAT II/III for SUMU) are current as of 2026. Vector PDF format (text-selectable). AIRAC-aligned. No AIXM or ARINC 424 coded data available.

countries.aip_authority: ECNA (Empresa Cubana de Navegacion Aerea) / IACC
countries.notes: ECNA publishes AIP at aismet.avianet.cu; AD section includes aerodrome charts in PDF format (e.g. MUHAAD_2.pdf confirmed at direct URL). No login required evident from structure but site frequently returns 503 (infrastructure reliability issues). Charts updated AIRAC cadence. Jetstream Charts re-sells Cuba AIP for ForeFlight users. No AIXM or ARINC 424 coded data. US embargo may complicate programmatic access. +1 for reliability/access friction.

BULATSA publishes Bulgarian AIP via B-FLIP portal (b-flip.bulatsa.com); portal has basic (free) and extended tiers; registration required. Also available via EUROCONTROL EAD AIP Library (free registration). eAIP HTML format assumed consistent with ECAC standard. No AIXM download evident. Score 5: eAIP behind free registration, consistent with EAD-tier states. Confidence medium as B-FLIP portal content/format not fully verified by direct fetch.

countries.aip_authority: Civil Aviation Authority of Solomon Islands (CAASI) / Aeropath NZ (AIP manager)
countries.notes: AIP managed by Aeropath New Zealand on behalf of CAASI. Publications must be ordered/purchased through CAASI or via shop.aeropath.aero; no free public download. Format is PDF (vector text, Aeropath standard). No eAIP HTML, no AIXM. Very limited procedure set (Honiara AGGH is primary IFR airport). Score 9 for paid access + formal ordering process + no coded data source. Aeropath shop URL returned 404 at time of verification; confidence medium.

Croatia Control fully transitioned to AIM Portal (aim.crocontrol.hr) as of 1 January 2026; old direct eAIP HTML URLs on crocontrol.hr now return 404. Mandatory registration required; portal distributes eAIP HTML plus amendments, supplements, aeronautical charts, and VFR manual. Also available via EAD AIP Library (free registration). No AIXM download found. Score 5: eAIP HTML behind mandatory free registration, clunky portal navigation post-transition.

Libya CAA AIS at caa.gov.ly/ais/ publishes AIP (GEN/ENR/AD sections) as downloadable PDFs — vector text, not scanned — freely accessible with no login. Active updates confirmed: AIP AMDT 001/26 (06-Apr-2026), AIP SUP 008/26. However, Libya is a severe conflict zone: FAA prohibits US civil flights (through 2028), UK/EASA advise against. ATC services unreliable per EASA CZIB-2017-02. AIP may not reflect actual airspace state; reliability of procedure data is uncertain. Score 8: open vector PDF but conflict-zone friction (+1), AIP maintenance intermittent.

Lithuania is an ECAC/EAD state. Oro navigacija publishes AIRAC-aligned eAIP (HTML) at ans.lt using Managed-AIS/apsXML (EAD-integrated toolchain). eAIP downloadable directly from ans.lt without login (large ~500-700 MB bundles). Also available via EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free registration required) in AIXM 5.1 format. Score 5 applies for the EAD free-account route (primary coded data source); direct ans.lt HTML download is open but procedure tables require parsing. AIXM 5.1 via EAD is the preferred machine-readable source.

Nigeria AIP is published by NAMA AIS (aishq@nama.gov.ng). No public online eAIP portal confirmed as of 2025-2026; AIP is distributed on CD at approx. USD 180/year with updates every ~4 months. Physical pickup at NAMA HQ, Ikeja Lagos, or via AIS-to-AIS request for overseas users. PDF format (vector text) per partial documents found on airportdata.com. No AIXM or ARINC 424 export. Score 9: paid/physical distribution with no open online access.

Central African Republic (FEFF Bangui M'Poko) is an ASECNA member state; AIP managed by ASECNA at aim.asecna.aero. eAIP HTML AD-2 sections open/no login; procedures in vector PDF charts (IAP ILS Y RWY 35 confirmed at aim.asecna.aero/…/04AD2-FEFF-IAC-ILSY35.pdf). CAR is a severe conflict zone: armed groups control large areas, FEFF operating under UN control with frequent power outages; US/UK advise against travel. ASECNA maintains the AIP nominally but operational reliability is degraded. Score 8: open vector PDF charts via ASECNA (+1 conflict/instability friction).

EANS publishes fully open eAIP HTML at eaip.eans.ee (AIRAC-cycle URL pattern /YYYY-MM-DD/html/eAIP/EE-*). Tallinn EETN AD-2 section confirmed to contain SID/STAR tables with RNAV waypoint coordinates, altitude/speed constraints, and approach procedures in structured tabular form. Mixed English/Estonian content complicates parsing slightly. Also available at aim.eans.ee and via EAD. No AIXM download found. Score 4: open eAIP HTML with parseable tables but minor structural irregularities.

Kazaeronavigatsia publishes full AIRAC-aligned eAIP (HTML + PDF) at ans.kz; open access, no login required. Instrument flight procedure datasets available in AIXM 5.1 format upon free email request to aip@ans.kz (no subscription fee). eAIP HTML sections directly browseable (GEN, ENR, AD). Score 4 reflects open eAIP HTML with irregular structure; AIXM 5.1 availability on request lowers effective parsing cost but the email-request barrier (not direct download) prevents score 2.

Lesotho DCA website (civilair.org.ls) was unreachable (ECONNREFUSED) during research. No active eAIP or online AIP portal found through any search. Lesotho publishes its own AIP and NOTAMs (confirmed by ICAO AFI references). FXMM Moshoeshoe I has IFP charts (visible on Navigraph). AIP appears to be distributed via AIS office contact only. Procedures presumably exist as vector PDF given modern ICAO compliance, but no public download confirmed. Confidence low due to inaccessible official website and lack of online publication evidence.

ROMATSA publishes AIP at aisro.ro; index at aisro.ro/aip/YYYY-MM-DD/index.html links to English and Romanian HTML versions. AD-2 aerodrome sections are vector PDFs (Microsoft Word-origin, selectable text) containing procedure charts; some procedure tabular data may appear in HTML sections. EAD AIP Library also provides access. No AIXM download found. Confidence medium: aisro.ro frameset structure and PDF delivery model partially verified; full HTML procedure table availability not confirmed by direct fetch.

countries.aip_authority: IDAC (Instituto Dominicano de Aviacion Civil) / DINA
countries.notes: IDAC publishes eAIP-style web portal at aip.sna.gob.do with HTML navigation and direct PDF chart links per aerodrome procedure. Instrument approach charts (RNAV, GLS, VOR-DME, ILS) for MDSD and MDPC confirmed at predictable URLs (e.g. /Datos/1AD/Charts_Proc/Procedures/MDPC_Proc_AD2/). AIRAC-aligned. Vector PDF (text-selectable). AIP amended quarterly plus AIRAC. Portal intermittently 503. No AIXM or coded data.

countries.aip_authority: National Air Navigation Services Company (NANSC / NANSCEG)
countries.notes: Egypt NANSC produces AIP via COMSOFT CADAS-EPS (EUROCONTROL-compatible eAIP production tool), but the public-facing portal (nansceg.net) serves PDF amendments only; no publicly accessible eAIP HTML portal found. AIRAC AIP amendments (e.g. AMDT 5/25, effective Oct 2025) are PDF documents directly downloadable from nansceg.net without login. Charts appear to be vector PDF (CADAS output). No AIXM export confirmed. Portal was returning 503 during verification. Score 7 for open but PDF-only access with clunky portal navigation and no eAIP HTML.

countries.aip_authority: CAAV (Civil Aviation Authority Vanuatu) via Aeropath
countries.notes: CAAV delegates AIP publication to Aeropath (New Zealand). AIP Vanuatu available as digital PDF at $0.00 NZD via Aeropath shop but requires account registration and checkout process. Covers NVVV (Port Vila) with SIDs, STARs, RNAV/VOR/NDB approaches. Most recent edition effective November 2025, amendments follow AIRAC cadence. PDF format presumed vector. CAAV website provides no direct AIP download. +1 for mandatory account/shop portal.

countries.aip_authority: CAAI (Civil Aviation Authority of Israel) / MAPA GISrael
countries.notes: Open eAIP HTML at e-aip.azurefd.net (Azure CDN); no registration required per direct page access. Published by MAPA GISrael on behalf of CAAI. SID/STAR/IAP charts linked as PDF files from HTML aerodrome sections. AIRAC-cycle updates confirmed (Oct 2025 cycle visible). Non-commercial use restriction noted in terms. No AIXM data found. Israel is not ECAC so EAD Basic coverage is limited.

Open eAIP HTML at ais.mn, published by CAAM using Indra Avitech eWiz platform; no login required. SID/STAR/IAP charts linked as vector PDFs from HTML aerodrome pages. AIRAC-cycle updates confirmed through mid-2025. No AIXM. Moderate number of airports with IFR procedures (primarily ZMCK Ulaanbaatar). PDF files appear to have selectable text.

countries.aip_authority: LPS SR (Letové prevádzkové služby Slovenskej republiky)
countries.notes: LPS SR publishes standard EUROCONTROL eAIP HTML at aim.lps.sk; free registration confirmed required for all content. ECAC state; data also available via EAD Basic (free account, AIXM 5.1). AIRAC-cycle aligned. No open anonymous access to procedure sections.

Open eAIP HTML at ais.caa.gov.tw; no login required. SID/STAR/IAP delivered as linked vector PDFs embedded in eAIP HTML aerodrome pages. AIRAC-cycle amendments published per ICAO schedule. No AIXM data. Charts have selectable text (created MS Office/CAD). URL structure is complex but all content is public.

AIP Fiji Islands published by Airports Fiji Ltd as AIS provider; login-gated portal (airportsfiji.com/ais-fiji) with subscription required — PPRuNe forum reports ~NZD 350 single-use purchase. Format is PDF (vector text confirmed from GEN section sample). No AIXM, no open download. AIRAC-aligned amendment service. No free-account path. Procedures (SID/STAR/IAP) are embedded as PDF chart pages. +1 friction for portal account and subscription paywall.

eAIP published via COCESNA (Eurocontrol eAIP tool); HTML frameset index plus procedure charts as vector PDFs embedded in eAIP tree (e.g. MN_AD-2 ILS charts). Top-level HTML and text sections are machine-readable; SID/STAR/IAP content is in PDF chart files within the eAIP package, not in HTML tables. INAC also mirrors a full PDF AIP at inac.gob.ni. No registration needed. AIRAC cycle updates confirmed 2025. Score 6 (open vector PDF in eAIP) +1 for frameset navigation complexity = 7.

ASECNA unified eAIP covers all 18 member states. HTML pages (aim.asecna.aero/html/eAIP/) are open without login; procedure data lives in PDF charts under /cartes/atlas/gabon/ (e.g. FOOL SID-RNP16, STAR VOR-DME, IAC-ILS). At least one sampled chart (FOOL NDB16) appeared scanned/rasterised; others may be vector. AIXM 4.5 dataset available on paid subscription (€100/yr). eAIP updated per AIRAC cycle. Per-chart PDF navigation adds friction (+1 from base 6).

Mali is ASECNA member state; same unified eAIP at aim.asecna.aero as Gabon/Cameroon. ICAO prefix GA. HTML pages open without login; procedures in PDF charts under /cartes/atlas/mali/ (Bamako GABS and others). AIXM 4.5 trial dataset via €100/yr subscription. Chart PDFs include SID, STAR, IAC types; format quality varies (some raster, some vector). Per-chart manual navigation adds friction (+1).

SIA-Maroc (Office National des Aéroports) publishes AIP as PDF documents directly at siamaroc.onda.ma/eaip/ — no login required, URLs are publicly indexed. AD2 sections (e.g. AD2GMMN, AD2GMME, AD2GMML) and individual chart PDFs (SID, STAR, IAC series) are available. Content appears vector/text-selectable based on document structure evidence. AIRAC-aligned updates confirmed through AIRAC 06/2026. No AIXM export. No eAIP HTML procedure tables — procedures are chart PDFs only.

countries.aip_authority: CAAV / VATM - Vietnam Aeronautical Information Centre (VNAIC)
countries.notes: Open eAIP HTML at aim.vatm.vn (VNAIC/VATM); no login required. SID/STAR/IAP charts are linked vector PDF graphics from HTML aerodrome pages. Bilingual (English/Vietnamese). Updated per AIRAC cycle (5 amendments/year plus AIRAC cycles). Confirmed Sep 2025 AIRAC available. No AIXM. RNP procedures well-represented. Portal URL structure is long/indirect but fully public.

Cameroon is ASECNA member state. ASECNA eAIP covers FKKD (Douala) and FKYS (Yaoundé) with confirmed STAR RNAV30 and IAC ILS30 chart PDFs at aim.asecna.aero/html/eAIP/cartes/atlas/cameroun/. HTML eAIP pages open without login; chart PDFs also appear publicly accessible. AIXM 4.5 trial via subscription. AIRAC-aligned updates. Per-chart PDF navigation friction (+1 from base 6).

Sudan has an eAIP at scaa-aim.gov.sd producing HTML output (e.g. ENR-5.1 section confirmed). However, the portal uses a JavaScript-based DDoS-protection verification screen that blocks automated access. Active civil war since April 2023: Khartoum FIR (HSSS) closed, HSSS/Khartoum airport non-operational; SCAA relocated to Port Sudan (HSPN). AIP data currency is highly questionable — last confirmed HTML update was March 2022. +1 for verification-screen friction and conflict-zone data reliability issues.

countries.aip_authority: IACM (Instituto de Aviação Civil de Moçambique)
countries.notes: No public digital AIP portal identified. IACM website (iacm.gov.mz) has no AIP/eAIP section. Historical AIC documents reference a paid subscription model ($100-150 USD) for physical/PDF AIP distribution. No online eAIP, no AIXM, no open chart download portal found as of June 2026. Procedures may be obtainable via formal request to IACM AIS office or commercial providers (Jeppesen/Navigraph). Confidence medium as a fully-accessible portal may exist but was not discoverable.

DINAC publishes AIP Paraguay as a downloadable RAR/PDF archive (Spanish; English GEN section available). PDF is vector text (selectable, not scanned; confirmed from AIP_PARAGUAY_ENGLISH_AMDT_21 sample). Charts are vector PDF. No eAIP HTML, no AIXM. Free direct download from dinac.gov.py with no account required. Update cadence irregular (roughly 1-2 amendments per year rather than strict AIRAC). Score 6 for open vector PDF without HTML structure.

SSCAA publishes AIP as PDF sections at sscaa.gov.ss with open public access. New SID/STAR/RNP APCH procedures for Juba (HSSJ) developed from 2023; Feb 2024 amendment published. PDFs appear vector/text-based (new-generation), not scanned. Conflict-zone context (ongoing instability); AIS capacity limited; no AIXM, no coded database. Single main airport (Juba); ground truth verification only by consensus. +1 for fragile AIS infrastructure.

eAIP HTML hosted on GCAA website at gcaa.gov.ae; free but requires user registration (Sign In visible on portal page). AIP distributed in electronic format only (no paper). SID/STAR/IAP charts available as PDF files linked from eAIP HTML. AIRAC-cycle updated. AIM Data Sets advertised but AIXM format not confirmed for public download. +1 for registration requirement elevates from score 6.

countries.aip_authority: ASECNA (Agence pour la Sécurité de la Navigation Aérienne en Afrique et à Madagascar)
countries.notes: ASECNA eAIP at aim.asecna.aero is publicly accessible (no login). Aerodrome reference data in HTML; all SID/STAR/IAP procedures are vector PDF charts (CorelDRAW-origin, text-selectable, confirmed for DIAP Abidjan). French-language only. ASECNA covers all 18 member states under shared portal; CI procedures under country prefix 06. ASECNA in early AIXM 4.5 implementation phase per APIRG-23 report; no coded database yet. AIRAC-cycle aligned.

countries.aip_authority: DGAC Guatemala (Dirección General de Aeronáutica Civil)
countries.notes: Guatemala AIP published within the COCESNA Central America eAIP (from AMDT 25/23 all CA states are consolidated). Eurocontrol eAIP tool: HTML frameset for text/table sections, procedure charts (SID/STAR/IAP) as vector PDFs in the eAIP Maps subtree (confirmed MG_AD-2.MGGT IAC RNP and VOR charts). DGAC also maintains dgac.gob.gt/home/aip_e/ but it redirects to COCESNA. Open, no registration. Score 6 (open vector PDF charts in eAIP) +1 for multi-country frameset navigation = 7.

MCAA established 2023 (transitioned from DCA). No publicly accessible eAIP portal found on caa.gov.mw. ICAO APIRG targeted Malawi for eAIP by 2025 but no live portal confirmed. AIP likely available on paper or PDF by direct request; no online distribution channel identified. No AIXM, no coded database. Main airports FWKI (Lilongwe) and FWCL (Blantyre). Confidence low as no direct portal verification possible.

countries.aip_authority: SMATSA (Serbia and Montenegro Air Traffic Services)
countries.notes: SMATSA publishes eAIP HTML directly at smatsa.rs/upload/aip/published/ with no login required; individual section URLs confirmed publicly accessible. ECAC state; also available via EAD Basic (AIXM 5.1). eAIP effective date confirmed June 2026. Covers Serbia and Montenegro under LY prefix. Disclaimer: informational use only, not for operational navigation.

UCAA AIM portal at aim.caa.co.ug provides eAIP, amendments, supplements and AIC behind annual paid subscription (AIP subscription form required). Format is eAIP online plus paper/CD. GNSS approaches for Entebbe (HUEN) operational on test basis. No AIXM export. Subscription fee amount not publicly listed. Confidence medium as fee structure and exact eAIP format not fully verified.

countries.aip_authority: AAC El Salvador (Autoridad de Aviación Civil) via COCESNA
countries.notes: El Salvador AIP published via COCESNA eAIP (Eurocontrol tool); same architecture as Guatemala/Nicaragua — HTML frameset for GEN/ENR text, SID/STAR/IAP as vector PDF charts in eAIP Maps tree (e.g. MS_AD-2.MSLP SID RWY 25, IAC RNP Z). AAC also maintains aac.gob.sv/aip/ but content is served via COCESNA. Fully open, no account. AIRAC and non-AIRAC amendments published 2024-2026. Score 6 (open vector PDF in eAIP) +1 for frameset complexity = 7.

Yemen is an active conflict zone (EASA CZIB, Safe Airspace Do-Not-Fly). Sana'a Airport (OYSN) was struck Dec 2024 and closed through May 2025. CAMA website (cama.gov.ye) has no online eAIP or downloadable AIP; only administrative pages. AIRAC AIP Amendment 02/24 referenced in Aden NOTAM suggests an AIP nominally exists but it is not publicly accessible. Historical procedure charts circulate in scanned PDF form via third parties (Scribd). No direct digital distribution path confirmed. Conflict severely degrades AIS operations. Score: restricted/inaccessible = 9, +1 for active conflict/no digital path = 10.

countries.aip_authority: Civil Aviation Administration of Uzbekistan / Uzaeronavigation
countries.notes: AIP published by Uzaeronavigation (Civil Aviation Administration) at uzaeronavigation.com. Procedures delivered as vector PDFs (created in MS Word/Office, selectable text confirmed). Individual chart PDF URLs resolve without authentication suggesting partial open access, but the main AIS portal indicates subscription model. AIRAC-cycle updates confirmed through Oct 2025. No eAIP HTML framework; each chart is a standalone PDF. No AIXM. Score 7 reflects PDF-only format plus uncertain/partial access; confidence medium due to ambiguous subscription boundary.
